page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated AMD EPYC 7T83 physical cores running at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz, with a 1.0 thread-to-core ratio. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng scores placing the instance in the top 25% of tested systems. It demonstrates high efficiency in cryptographic operations, database transactions, and memory-bound tasks, as shown by strong Passmark scores and a Redis SET throughput of 61.81 million operations per second. While cached small-block memory bandwidth is highly competitive, uncached large-block read and write speeds fall into the average tier.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the absence of local storage, this instance is optimized for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local NVMe drives. It is well-suited for high-throughput batch processing, multi-threaded decompression, image processing, and small-scale LLM inference. However, workloads requiring large-model LLM execution or high-capacity local disk I/O may face performance bottlenecks due to the lack of local storage and specialized accelerators.
